description: Car Parking - Scotland is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Scottish Government SpatialData.gov.scot. Most councils keep records of their car parks, bays and zones, including parking-related TROs (Traffic Regulation Orders). Therefore we have tried to compile these into consistent national layers. Coverage: Scotland.gov.scot. The portal files it under the publisher Scottish Government SpatialData.gov.scot. Its tags are Area management/restriction/regulation zones and r, Land use, Transport networks, Utility and governmental services, car. The portal shows 2026-08-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
